# Atd

> Atd (anything, anytime, anywhere, to do) is a quiet desktop agent panel for macOS. A native app (macOS 15 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel) puts a small panel in the bottom-right corner of the screen; press ⌘ ⇧ Space anywhere to open it, and it runs coding and general-purpose agent tasks on your own Mac through a local agent service.

- [Website (English)](/): a scroll through the app's interfaces, its features and the download
- [Website (简体中文)](/zh): the same page in Simplified Chinese
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/JUNERDD/Atd): the native shell, the React UI and the agent service
- [Download for Apple silicon](https://downloads.atd.best/latest/Atd-arm64.dmg): the newest stable installer for Macs with Apple silicon (macOS 15 or later); saves as `Atd-<version>-arm64.dmg`
- [Download for Intel](https://downloads.atd.best/latest/Atd-x64.dmg): the newest stable installer for Intel Macs (macOS 15 or later); saves as `Atd-<version>-x64.dmg`
- [Releases](https://github.com/JUNERDD/Atd/releases): release notes and the arm64 and x64 dmg for each version
